headline: Week 11: McCalfinjury Goes Nuclear, Nut Olave Forgets How Lineups Work
subhead: Three teams cracked 170, one team scored 91, and Nick benched 57 points in a five-point loss — yes, that math is real.
matchOfTheWeek: Rub My Chubb 113.62 over Nut Olave Your Face 107.96 — the only game with any actual suspense between two teams that pretended to try. George Kittle dropped 27.7 for Big D, but the real story is Nick leaving Sean Tucker's 34-burger on the pine while losing by 5.66. That's not a loss, that's a self-inflicted gunshot wound.
powerRankingsShakeup: Christian McCalfinjury and Browning Out both posted 174+ and look like the scariest teams in the league heading into the stretch. QAmon, meanwhile, is freefalling with the week's lowest score and a roster that suddenly looks allergic to football.
mainRecap:
Let's start at the top, because Matt put on a clinic. Christian McCalfinjury hung 174.98 at 99.3% lineup efficiency — the man literally only left .56 points on the bench. CMC went for 35.1, the rest of the squad showed up, and T swift's Baddies got curb-stomped by 64. Tnicolle, you scored 110 — that's a respectable number in any week where your opponent doesn't summon a demon.

Browning Out wasn't far behind, dropping 174.44 on OnlyFants in the week's actual blowout (68.42). Patrick rode MICHAEL WILSON for 33.5 points — yes, the Cardinals' WR3, the guy you've never started in your life — plus a vintage Kelce 28.6. Cubby countered with 106 and a Kenneth Walker 20-burger rotting on his bench. Inspired stuff.

The Good Ladds put up 171.16 and somehow it feels underwhelming because 3rd Overall Somehow went for 44.68 and Tetty Bear added 33. Mig, you ALSO left Bryce Young's 31.82 on the bench — GOAT Young indeed. Egbukkake's 130 would've won most weeks; this week it got Egbukkake'd.

In the closest game, McBridesStrangeWhiteHock survived Little Peckers by 4.68 thanks to Trey McBride going full namesake (32.5). Rocks also imported Unc this week — Aaron Jones officially joins the squad while Papi sold the farm, shipping out Kyren, Keon Coleman, and Matthew Golden in a separate dump for picks. Rebuild speedrun any%.

Stroud Boys squeaked past QAmon 101.9 to 91.2 in the Bowl of Sadness. Kyle, your lineup put up a number that wouldn't crack most people's BENCH this week. Dead Rat, Tiny-Handed Vampire, MUUUUUUUTH — the nicknames are cooking, the points are not. The Prodigal Son went for 32.3 and that was basically Brendan's entire offense, which still beat you by 11.

weeklyAwards.title: The 'Lineups Are Hard' Trophy
weeklyAwards.blurb: Left 56.96 points on the bench including a 34-spot from Sean Tucker, then lost by 5.66 — a perfect crime against yourself.

weeklyAwards.title: Sneakiest WR1 of the Week
weeklyAwards.blurb: Started Michael Wilson, got 33.5, won by 68 — somewhere a Cardinals fan is more confused than Cubby.

weeklyAwards.title: Efficiency Demon
weeklyAwards.blurb: 99.3% optimal lineup and 174.98 points — Matt is playing chess while the league plays Madden franchise mode on rookie.

weeklyAwards.title: Punching Bag of the Week
weeklyAwards.blurb: 91.2 points, league low, and ShAmon-Ra didn't crack the top 10 — Kyle's roster looks like it caught Perc Hurts' flu.
